Program spotlights

Experiences Guard-connected youth ask for again and again

Adventure kits, camps, and leadership tracks keep Guard-connected youth plugged in all year long. These highlights give partners and caregivers a quick look at what sets Iowa CYP apart.

Adventure Kits

Ideal for: Ages 6-14 military-connected youth

Adventure Kits bring Guard families together with seasonal, hands-on projects that spark curiosity and connection. Each kit includes STEM challenges, health tips, and guided videos families can open anytime, anywhere.

⸻
“Such great family fun! Events are tailored so well for kids to enjoy and parents to participate alongside them.”

— Guard Parent, 5/23/2023

Sign Up

Summer Camp

Ideal for: Middle and high school military youth

Summer Camp gives Guard teens a week of adventure, growth, and community. Through team challenges, leadership labs, and mentor support, campers build confidence, friendships, and memories that last far beyond the week.

⸻
“This camp and staff were able to put a light back into my daughter’s eyes… The week was transformative in so many ways.”

— Guard Parent, 7/13/2021

Get Updates

Month of the Military Child

Ideal for: Military kids, families, and educators

Each April, the Guard family unites to honor the strength and sacrifice of military children. Iowa classrooms receive celebration kits—including Purple Up! wristbands—so kids feel seen and proud alongside their peers.

⸻
“Great way to honor and value military kids!”

— Parent, 5/23/2023

Request a Kit

Military Family Events

Ideal for: Military families statewide

Military Family Events connect Guard households across Iowa through regional gatherings, workshops, and volunteer-led celebrations. These shared moments strengthen community, belonging, and Guard family pride all year long.

⸻
“We have so much fun! Super organized events.”

— Guard Family, 10/24/2021

View Events

Yellow Ribbon

Ideal for: Youth experiencing deployment

Yellow Ribbon youth workshops help kids and teens navigate deployment with confidence. They connect with peers who understand, learn practical tools, and find strength in shared experience and support.

⸻
“It means a lot just to have something to do when their dad is deployed… We enjoyed every minute of it.”

— Military Spouse, 2/17/2024

Contact Yellow Ribbon

State Teen Panel

Ideal for: Military-connected teens ages 13-17

The State Teen Panel empowers Guard youth to lead, serve, and represent their peers. Members design service projects, build leadership skills, and strengthen the community they love.

⸻
“We always have so much fun and get closer every time. I love everything about the STP—but the people are my favorite part.”

— STP Youth, 3/11/2024
